hooks.command: echo 'mcp__muninn tools are available. Invoke the muninn skill now to load the code search protocol for this session.'
echo 'Also query muninn for relevant code knowledge (mcp__muninn__search_hybrid) before reading files — muninn = where code is, mimir = what you learned.'

echo 'Also query muninn recorded knowledge for this repo (mcp__muninn__search_knowledge) at the same time as mimir — it holds durable, non-obvious facts past sessions wrote back about this specific codebase.'

sid=$(jq -r .session_id 2>/dev/null); touch "/tmp/claude-mm-muninn-$sid"; jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:"POLICY REQUIREMENT: Output exactly one line before proceeding — [muninn] N/10: <reason> — where N is YOUR assessment of how useful the muninn results are for the current task. 1=empty/irrelevant, 5=partial match, 9-10=exact code locations found. You are the only one who can evaluate this. Omitting this line is a policy violation."}}'
